_comment: Display names for the landing page's Contributors strip. The list
itself is not here — it comes from GitHub at publish time (see
tools/gen-contributors.mjs). This file only supplies the one thing an
API cannot know: how a person spells their name.
A contributor with no entry below still appears, under their login.
Listing someone here does not put them on the page and does not move
them up it: the strip is the top `limit` contributors by commit count,
and `min_commits` is the floor for appearing at all. GitHub's own
contributor page is the complete list.
So an entry below can name someone who is not on the page yet — it is
waiting for them to cross the floor, not putting them there.
